entities.summary: Ilya Belyaev is a Russian tennis player playing on the ATP Challenger Tour. Balyaev has a highest ATP singles ranking of World No. 272 achieved on 21 February 2011 and a highest doubles ranking of No. 221 was achieved on 18 April 2011. He is coached by Mikhail Chesalov.
